structure_proposals.why: The cable lateral raise is the only side-delt work on Push A, and two reorders you accepted in August put the overhead triceps and then the reverse pec deck ahead of it, leaving it seventh of eight — on 27 August the session ended after the sixth exercise, so your side delts got nothing while your rear delts got all three sets, and every side-delt set logged in the last two weeks came from the dumbbell lateral raise on Push B; this moves it up to fifth, straight after the shoulder press, so it is done before the triceps tail rather than after it.
